findings_and_questions.observation: Sex has a derived snake_case native spelling and a separate explicit Female/Male stable_variant_id. In inspected 95e consumers, dialogue referral text uses stable_id, while generated_npc_presence_version includes stable_variant_id bytes in a length-framed version hash. Therefore the two projections have independently observable consumers; changing one may change this derived hash or dialogue text. Source tests describe expected JSON/parse behavior but were not executed.
findings_and_questions.qualification: This does not establish that keeping any historical spelling is required: the root rule forbids compatibility shims, and a future clean final identity scheme must follow current product and source contracts. No stale existing value, identity collision, broken consumer, supported schema migration or private string classifier has been demonstrated. Whether hash identity is persisted/recomputed and its complete consumers remain open. Strum0.28 macro source delegates snake conversion to native heck; no compiler, macro expansion or native serialization was executed. TEAM025 remains a later unadopted historical proposal, with no current verdict.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: After all audit work and implementation authorization, trace complete version-hash writers/consumers and intentional native display/seed boundaries before choosing a single clean schema and spelling policy; remove actual obsolete fallback paths within scope rather than add compatibility machinery.

nonfindings: The only declared Sex variants are Female and Male; the pinned Strum0.28 VariantArray source maps declared unit variants in declaration order. For the inspected two-element array, choose uses index/below(2), and boolean uses the same below(2)==0; with the same RNG state the source-level choice maps index0 to Female and index1 to Male. No RNG or macro was run.
A nonempty declared Sex array supports the selected resident, child and starting-character selection precondition; no claim that every caller or dependency version is covered.

Two representations have distinct explicit consumers; their spelling difference alone is not redundant mutable authority, an automatic compatibility violation, or a claim about universal biological categories.
Culture::German is the only declared current value in this bounded source. A one-variant enum is not itself proof of a broader localization or demographic defect.
Native serde/spacetimedb annotations indicate integration boundaries, not proof that a feature was activated, generated schema compiled, serialized values were accepted or a database worked.
The included tests and native macro code were source text only, not executed.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Typed Sex reaches inspected starting, child and resident producers; projected strings are used at selected dialogue and witness-version boundaries. Other paths remain open.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: World-schema Sex and Culture are shared owners; label-to-ID and semantic identity distinctions require actual consumer policy, not indiscriminate replacement of formatted native text.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Sex is a closed unit enum with serde/strum derives, while selected native macro source emits unit variants in declaration order and rejects unknown parse matches under its generated fallback. Native feature activation and whole serialization are not established.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Source choice and boolean use the same below(2) primitive from equal RNG state; changes to ordering change the deterministic mapping, a behavior dependency, not a demonstrated current bug.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Resident draft sets sex and presentation together, but starting-character policy can differ. Actual accepted persisted correlation and product intention need full lifecycle trace.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Sex owns the unit variants and label projections; catalog owns grouping and identity validation; witness version hash and dialogue output are different consumer boundaries.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Snake spelling and title-style stable variant projection have distinct selected consumers. Their coexistence does not establish independently mutable conflicting sex state.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: The selected deterministic choice is order-sensitive and the version hash incorporates the variant projection. Future design must assess real consequences and follow the no-compatibility rule; historical labels alone do not mandate fallback.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: Sex and Culture express closed cases rather than semantic booleans; presentation remains a separate concept in selected producers. No universal identity model or unsupported extrapolation from these variants is claimed.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: VariantArray, IntoStaticStr and EnumString are delegated to a pinned native derive; manual stable_variant_id has a distinct selected hash consumer. No blanket derive removal or macro execution is justified.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Differentiate sex, presentation, culture, catalog family and native seed/version identity; a finite variant name is not itself an authored name identity or proof of every person model.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: Typed variants feed external/consumer representations; selected witness hash version tag and labels are explicit boundary vocabulary. Their current owner/policy must be traced before treating them as private protocol duplication.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Two variants and index0/1 are fixed by the declared enum and source-derived VariantArray. Sampling uses a nonzero bound; no speculative new numerical restriction or output frequency claim.

limitations: Static source and offline evidence integrity only. No product edits, repairs, builds, tests, macro execution, fixture execution, runtime probes, rendering or publication checkout edits.
